working_definition: Tbh-positive subset of the parent Tdc2(+) cluster (Davie et al. 2018, res-2.0 cluster 64; 76 cells): octopamine-releasing neurons (Tbh converts tyramine to octopamine). Broadly distributed across the subesophageal zone and central-brain/optic-lobe-projecting groups (ventral unpaired median, ventral paired median, dorsal clusters); this atlas resolves the octopaminergic identity as a single neurotransmitter-class group without further anatomical subtyping.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any octopaminergic neuron of the adult (parent class; direct parent of specific octopaminergic neuron types such as octopaminergic AL2i1 neuron and adult octopaminergic subesophageal AkhR/InR neuron in FBbt).

justification: This is a class-level, neurotransmitter-defined cluster (Tbh+ subset of Tdc2+ neurons) explicitly not resolved to any anatomical subtype by the atlas. FBbt:00058203 'adult octopaminergic neuron' is the class-level FBbt term at exactly this resolution, restricted to adult tissue matching the confirmed adult (0-50 day) atlas. Per dataset guidance, remainder/class-level clusters map to the class term as the correct (not merely broad) level.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Any neuron that is capable of some octopamine secretion, neurotransmission.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Life-stage-unspecified parent; adult-specific FBbt:00058203 better matches the confirmed adult tissue.

recommendation: Accept adult octopaminergic neuron (FBbt:00058203) as the class-level mapping; no individual octopaminergic subtype (e.g. ventral unpaired median vs dorsal cluster) should be assigned.
